title: Why Your Brain Fills In Your Blind Spot Without You Noticing
hook: Your brain constantly invents parts of your vision.

narration.text: Your brain constantly invents parts of your vision.
Every eye has a natural blind spot.
This is where the optic nerve connects, with no light-sensing cells.
But you never see a blank patch.
That is because your brain uses surrounding visual information.
It estimates and fills in the missing details.
This happens so seamlessly, you are completely unaware of it.
It shows how our perception is an active construction.
Have you ever found your blind spot on purpose?

description: Our vision feels complete, but there is a hidden blind spot in each eye. Discover the fascinating way your brain actively fills in these gaps, creating a seamless picture of the world without you ever noticing.
topic: why your brain fills in your blind spot without you noticing
